historical_significance: 阿斋逊（1058-1111），伊斯兰黄金时代思想家，波斯伊斯兰哲学家、神学家、苏菲派神秘主义者，被尊为‘伊斯兰证道者’。他在伊斯兰教神学与哲学之间架起桥梁，批判阿维森纳的哲学体系，并撰写《宗教科学复兴》四十卷巨著，涵盖神学、神秘主义、伦理学和法学。他著名的代表作《辨误》和《哲学倒置论》展示了他对伊斯兰教正统与希腊哲学的辩证关系。他的思想深刻影响了伊斯兰哲学的发展，被尊为‘伊斯兰证道者’。
historical_significance_en: Al-Ghazali (1058-1111), Islamic Golden Age thinker, Persian Islamic philosopher, theologian, and Sufi mystic, known as the 'Proof of Islam'. He built a bridge between Islamic theology and philosophy, criticizing Avicenna's philosophical system, and wrote the monumental 40-volume 'Revive the Religious Sciences', covering theology, mysticism, ethics, and jurisprudence. His famous works 'Deliverance from Error' and 'Incoherence of the Philosophers' demonstrate the dialectical relationship between Islamic orthodoxy and Greek philosophy. His thought profoundly influenced the development of Islamic philosophy, known as the 'Proof of Islam'.
key_concepts: 伊斯兰教正统与哲学辩证
